title.narrative: Preparing the ground for Climate Smart and Nutrition Sensitive Agriculture for improving Food Secuirty (SaNSA) in Mali and Niger

description.narrative:
The main objective of this project is to consolidate previous Norwegian investments in CSAT and REDSACC projects and to pave the way for a potential new larger phase II-project following this bridge funding. In existing project communities the project will continue their efforts while laying the ground for potential to scale up if new funding becomes available in 2026.
Objectives: 1. Consolidate the partnership by strengthening strategic existing collaborations for creation of conducive environment for adoption of introduced technologies. 2. Demonstration of new climate smart options and train farmers on their use, this will specially be focused on off-season farming. 3. Conduct a stakeholder’s consultation to ensure large buy ins on the new proposed project and document lessons learned in past phase to be incorporated in a new project. 4. Develop the new project proposal document with corresponding budget and results framework.
